messages:
maya_support: FYI — AcmeCorp opened a request to increase quota on /v1/generate from 200 rps to 2k rps for a one-off marketing event next week. Ticket: https://redwood.support/tkt/45872. I flagged it because we see many short bursts from different IPs tied to the same api_key_prefix=ak_3fH***. Adding here for product + security triage.
liam_pm: thanks maya. can you paste a short usage sample + business justification from the customer? need that for prioritization. also what's the timeframe?
maya_support: customer says 2026-03-25 14:00-18:00 UTC window. justification: live chat & personalized messaging during campaign. usage sample (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_3fHxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"...","max_tokens":128}'
```
We see ~1.8k rps peaks but distributed across ~150 source IPs, and some 429s.
asha_security: tagging in Security. that many IPs + short bursts looks like potential credential stuffing or proxy farming. we need: 1) Sales verification (is this expected), 2) 24h logs (ip,user_agent,timestamp,resp_code), 3) an abuse score run. do not approve permanent increase until we verify.
corbin_sre: if we need a quick mitigation path: we can put a soft/conditional increase for the event window only, with per-key burst cap (e.g., 2k sustained but 300 wide-burst cap) and elevated monitoring hooks + auto-rollbacks. I'll need routing config change and a rollout job. estimate 2-3 hours ops work. runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/rate-limit-escalations
jonah_sales: AcmeCorp is a paid customer (Enterprise Tier). I confirmed contact: amy@acme.com (eng ops). They insist it's legitimate — running a promo across partners. Sales will send a signed event addendum (email pending).
liam_pm: launch criteria for approving temporary bump: - signed addendum from Sales - security abuse sign-off (asha) - SRE mitigation plan + monitoring (corbin) - support on-call ready to rollback if anomalous. timeline? customer wants confirmation by EOD.
asha_security: I'll run an abuse scoring job now and will need full logs for the preceding 24h and the last 30 minutes at high fidelity. if scoring > threshold we recommend denial + require rotated key. If low risk, we can clear a timeboxed increase with monitoring. Also request we tag this account with "manual-abuse-review" so future increases go through FraudOps.
auto-deploy-bot: Policy ticket created: POL-2026-673 (quota-escalation-review). Assigned: security, sres, product.
maya_support: I attached exported logs to the ticket and added the Sales addendum draft. I've applied a provisional soft limit raise to 800 rps for next 2 hours while we complete checks so their service doesn't immediately fail. will watch metrics and post updates here.
corbin_sre: noted — we'll configure per-key burst guard and a net new alert (error_rate > 5% or 5xx rate spike) to paging. prepping rollout change now, will post PR and link to canary.
liam_pm: sounds good. once Security posts sign-off and Sales posts signed addendum we can approve a timeboxed 2k rps window with explicit rollback rules. Maya — please log customer communications and set a follow-up in 24h.
asha_security: sign-off pending abuse-score job (running). provisional checklist: customer contact verified, addendum on file, 24h logs uploaded, manual tag in account. I'll update within 30m.
maya_support: will do. updating ticket and pinging Amy for signed addendum.
jonah_sales: I'll follow up with Amy now and paste confirmation here when I have it.
asha_security: update: abuse score = LOW (0.12), no clear proxy fingerprinting, no credential stuffing indicators. recommending timeboxed increase with per-key burst caps + rotate key post-event.
liam_pm: approve timeboxed increase pending SRE PR and monitoring in place. set end_time = 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z, automatic rollback at end_time. thanks team.
maya_support: implemented timeboxed increase to 2k rps for the event window, per instructions. will monitor and escalate immediately if we see anomalies. closing loop in ticket.
